reason: The refrigeration insert and metal stock seem like a natural starting point for building the case.
expectation: I expect to make a rigid case around the refrigeration insert, though it may still need insulation and cold packs.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the cold packs also seems useful, but I want to build the case first.

effect: The metal stock and insert made a powered field case with a core cradle and an external radiator. It still appears to need insulation and prepared cold packs.
reaction: The detail about rejecting heat outdoors made me curious about how the case works in Mars’s thin air.
reason: Insulation felt should help the case retain its low temperature.
expectation: I expect the felt to insulate the refrigerated case, though it may still need the cold packs.

alternatives.reason: Freezing the cold packs also seems necessary, but I want to finish insulating the case first.

effect: The case is insulated while its radiator and power connection remain exposed, so it can still reject heat.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the insulation fitted without blocking the radiator.
reason: Preparing the cold packs is the only numbered action available and seems useful for the case.
expectation: I expect the freezer to chill the packs so they can help keep the core cold.

effect: The packs are conditioned for a limited transfer and need refrigeration to restore their heat-absorbing capacity.
reaction: That distinction made the packs’ role clearer.
reason: Combining the packs with the insulated case is the only numbered action and should prepare it for the core.
expectation: I expect the packs to fit into the case and provide temporary cooling support alongside its refrigerator.

effect: The completed case combines active refrigeration near minus 45 degrees with frozen cartridges that provide a short margin during power changes.
reaction: The specific role of the cartridges made the finished case feel practical and satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the refrigerated case was most worthwhile because its external radiator explained how it can reject heat in Mars’s thin air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the insulation was straightforward and less interesting as a decision, though keeping the radiator exposed was a useful detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the cold packs provide only a limited transfer margin and need active refrigeration to restore their capacity.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the last two steps each offered only one numbered action.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the second core reveals and how the specimens get home; the case preparation makes that next part feel close.
